title: Grilled Salmon Kebabs
description: Marinated salmon fillets grilled to perfection on skewers with vegetables and served with a side of tangy Russian dressing.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, and Russian dressing.
Add the sliced onions, bell peppers, and zucchini to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Thread the salmon onto the skewers, nesting it among the vegetables.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the salmon is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the kebabs hot with a side of additional Russian dressing for dipping.
Garnish with fresh dill or parsley, if desired.
